methodology: Representative sampling across all 16 required source families plus enterprise profile and industry overlay. Item-level DB-internal IDs (parser_record_id, evidence_id, candidate_id, canonical_object_id, projection_row_id) are uniformly marked lineage_gap because live Postgres was unreachable from this environment and no per-row lineage export is checked into the repository for the operational-landing families (only the restricted-evaluator crosswalk has per-row IDs, and that crosswalk is evaluator-only, not the operational lineage path). Family-to-projection correspondence is assessed via aggregate row-count reconciliation against clients/airline-demo-new/21-processing-wave-execution/08-foundation-closure/foundation-closure-authority-record-20260729.json and clients/shared/20-phase3c2d-consumption-contracts/CONSUMPTION_PROJECTION_REGISTRY.json, not by tracing individual rows end to end.
